name: Bor Wildmane
label: Quest
description: Bor Wildmane: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now that you have a medallion and can summon an Abyssal Duke, speak with Bor Wildmane. He will set you on a task against the Abyssal Council.
Good luck, friend. And if you ever need more medallions, return to me.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Good to see you again, adventurer! So you had a medallion made? Good -- you'll need that for your next quest...
